how to get max sales on a product

In my experience scaling brands from zero to millions of customers, maximizing sales isn't just about cranking up ad spend or slashing prices. Running heavy discounts usually backfires by killing margins and attracting one-time bargain hunters. 

To drive maximum revenue sustainably, I focus on a few key levers:

1. **Increase Average Order Value (AOV) with Guided Selling:** Instead of just relying on self-serve checkout, offer consultative or assisted sales. When I led Lukewarm (a D2C skincare brand), we used skincare specialists to guide customers through purchase decisions. That pushed our AOV to over ₹3,000—nearly 8 to 10 times the industry average—without relying on discounts.

2. **Fix the Leaky Bucket (Retention over Acquisition):** Getting a new customer is expensive. Real sales volume and profitability come from high Customer Lifetime Value (LTV). Setting up automated lifecycle flows—via WhatsApp, email, or CRM triggers—ensures customers reorder at the right time based on their purchase history.

3. **Data-Driven Targeting & Segmentation:** Use RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation to identify your top 20% of buyers and look for patterns in what makes them buy. Focusing sales and marketing automation on high-intent customer profiles yields much higher conversion rates.

4. **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO):** Streamline the buying experience, reduce checkout friction, and make value propositions crystal clear on the product pages.
